title: Brick Kart
description: A Mario Kart-style racer built from LEGO-style bricks: 20 big maps in 6 cups, including a Movie Cup with Jurassic World, Star Wars, Marvel and Harry Potter tracks, a JJK Run cup with a Jujutsu Kaisen map for every season up to the Culling Games, and a Video Game Cup with Minecraft, Pokémon and Sonic the Hedgehog tracks, all full of brick-built characters. 106 movie and video game characters drive with Mario Kart-style cheers, taunts and tricks. Gliders, hazards, 12 racers per race, 23 power-ups plus 34 movie and game powers, 25 gliders to choose from, drifting mini-turbos, and 1-8 player split-screen with controller support.
